text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When something goes wrong in your code, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages carefully and testing different parts of the program. Good debugging tools, such as debuggers and code editors, help you pause the program and inspect variables. It is also wise to follow a systematic approach: change one thing at a time and check the result, so you always know what caused the problem. Finally, logging is very useful. Adding log messages to your code shows what the program is doing and helps you find where the bug appears.
